title: Magnifier
shortcut.label: Magnifier
settings.backend.label: Magnifier backend
settings.backend.description: Which magnifier to launch. Each backend is installed separately; Custom runs your own command.
settings.zoom.label: Zoom level
settings.zoom.description: Initial zoom, 1 to 9. Passed to Maggie as -z and to hyprmag as -s. Ignored by wooz and by custom commands.
settings.binary_path.label: Binary path
settings.binary_path.description: Optional path to the magnifier executable. Leave empty to search PATH.
settings.custom_command.label: Custom command
settings.custom_command.description: Shell command run instead of a built-in backend. Trusted: it runs exactly as written.
settings.delay_ms.label: Start delay (ms)
settings.delay_ms.description: Wait this long before launching, so open popups close before the screen is captured.
notify.missing.title: Magnifier not found
notify.missing.body: {program} is not installed. See {url} for installation instructions.
notify.custom_missing.title: No custom command
notify.custom_missing.body: Set a custom command in the Magnifier plugin settings, or pick a built-in backend.
notify.running.title: Already running
